limits: The BSEQ check searches only the listed raw-byte encodings; other encodings, indirect IDs, and generated runtime IDs are outside its scope.
HIRC results are taken from the hash-linked wwise_unreferenced_wem.jsonl map and its validated BNK/XML receipts.
A local HIRC or DIDX match is static evidence and does not prove runtime loading or playback.
semantics: Static identifier search only. No finding establishes whether a loose WEM is loaded, invoked, selected, or played at runtime.
